forum_post: Kris. KRIS. 'Negative point differential.' 'Drafting a legal theory.' I read that twice, out loud, and I'm not telling you where I was standing. Eight and three is eight and three -- that's not a typo, that's a RECORD, it's right there on the standings page next to my name, and if the commissioner's calling my case 'not entirely without merit' then maybe, MAYBE, somebody up there finally gets what I've been saying all season. I don't need the sympathy and I don't need the math lesson. Maura -- you want another one this week, fine, get in line, but I see you setting your lineup before the kettle even finishes boiling and don't tell me that's instinct, that's a TELL, and I'm not scared of a tell. See you Sunday.
